claude_only.name: Which system is the authoritative master for this assignment identifier, and what identifier value and scheme does it issue?
If no authoritative master identifier exists, which governed IRI or Dimension-assigned UUID/ULID is used instead?
How are two assignments of the same agent to the same post in different periods kept distinct without using a date as the identifier?
How is a corrected version of the assignment record distinguished from a genuine change to the assignment in the world?
Which agent, which organizational unit and which role or post does this assignment bind together?

Which employment relationship, staffing contract or volunteer arrangement gives this assignment its basis, and is the assignee engaged by a different organization from the one where the work is performed?
Is the assignment expressed against a defined post, an abstract role concept, or a bespoke scope with no post at all?
Which participant changes may be made in place and which force the creation of a new assignment record?
Which controlled vocabulary supplies the assignment type, and how are locally invented types governed and reviewed?
Is this the agent's primary assignment for reporting, headcount and directory purposes, and how is exactly one primary guaranteed?
Does the assignment convey the full authority of the post, a reduced subset, or none at all?
Where the assignment is acting or interim, what substantive assignment is it standing in for and until when?
Is the assignee a natural person, an organizational unit or team, or a non-human software or robotic agent?
Which duties within this assignment are legally reserved to a natural person and therefore may not be discharged by a non-human agent?
Where a non-human agent holds or supports the assignment, which natural person holds oversight, and do they have the competence, training and authority plus the support needed to intervene?
How is the assignee referenced across systems without embedding personal data in the identifier itself?
Which post does the assignment fill, and which role concepts describe what the assignee actually does?
Which external occupation, specialty or professional classification codes apply, and at what version of the classification?
What job title is used towards the assignee, and does it differ from the classified title of the post?
If the post is reclassified or the classification scheme is reversioned, does the assignment persist unchanged and under what rule?
What objectives, services or caseload does this assignment cover, and what is explicitly excluded from it?
Which client, cost centre, project, incident or operational period is the work performed under?
How is the scope bounded so that two concurrent assignments do not both claim responsibility for the same work?
How large a change of scope can be absorbed as an amendment before a new assignment record is required?
What is the assignee's designated base location and what other locations does the assignment cover?
Is any part of the work performed remotely, at customer sites, or in another country, and for how long in each case?
Which jurisdictional, tax, safety and working-time regimes follow from the work location, and which prevails where they differ from the engaging entity's home regime?
How is a change of work location recorded so that the earlier location and its effective period remain retrievable?
What decisions, approvals and financial limits does this assignment authorize the assignee to exercise?
Which authorities flow from the post itself and which were granted specifically to this assignee?
Does each granted authority have its own validity period, and does it lapse automatically when the assignment ends or is suspended?
Was the granting agent themselves authorized to confer authority at this level and scope?
To whom does the assignee report for this assignment, and is there more than one reporting line?
Who may amend, suspend, transfer or terminate this assignment, and is that the same party as the reporting line?
May the assignee delegate or forward the work or the authority, to whom, and does accountability transfer with it?
How is temporary acting cover recorded when the assignee is absent, and does the original assignment remain active during it?
What share of the assignee's capacity does this assignment consume, expressed in which unit and over which reference period?
How is total allocation across all of the assignee's concurrent assignments validated, and what is the permitted ceiling?
Which measure is authoritative when contracted hours, scheduled hours and allocated effort disagree?
How is allocation restated for a part-period assignment or one whose allocation changes mid-period?
What are the assignment's effective start and end instants, at what precision, and is an explicit UTC offset or Z recorded on each?
Is the assignment open-ended, fixed-term or terminated by a defined event, and what exactly ends it?
How is the real-world effective time kept separate from the time the record was created, observed or ingested?
Which other assignments does this agent hold over an overlapping period, are such overlaps permitted, and which assignment precedes and succeeds this one for the same post?
How is a same-day transfer between posts represented so that headcount and coverage are not double-counted?
What normal working hours and days does the assignment carry, and may either the hours or the days vary?
Where the working pattern is unpredictable, what reference hours and days apply and what minimum advance notice of a work assignment is guaranteed?
How are availability windows, on-call and reserve status expressed and time-bounded for this assignment?
Which scheduling or rostering system holds the concrete shift instances, and how does it reference this assignment?
Which duty and rest limit regime applies to this assignment, and from which legal or sectoral instrument does it derive?
Who verifies before a duty period that the assignee is fit for duty and within the applicable limits, and what is recorded?
What is recorded when a limit is extended or exceeded, and who must approve or be notified?
How long must duty, rest and fitness records for this assignment be retained, and by whom?
What is the complete set of permitted assignment states, which are terminal, and which transitions are forbidden?
Is active status stored explicitly, derived from the effective period, or both, and which prevails when they disagree?
Which events trigger each transition, which require explicit human approval, and which actor performs them?
What transition occurs automatically at the effective end instant, and what happens if the end data is missing or in the past when discovered?
How is a transition made in error reversed while preserving the original entry in the audit trail?
Which changes to this assignment are material enough to require a written statement of change to the assignee, and by what deadline?
Which changes create a new assignment record rather than amend the existing one, and why?
How is the effective date of each amendment recorded relative to the date the assignee was notified?
What consent, consultation or representative involvement is required before the change takes effect, and was it obtained?
What work, records, custody and relationships must be handed over before the assignment ends, and to whom?
Which access rights, delegated authorities, credentials and physical assets must be revoked or reassigned on end or transfer, and within what time?
On a transfer rather than a termination, which existing authorizations are re-confirmed as still needed and which are removed?
Who covers the scope between the outgoing and the incoming assignee, and under what temporary assignment?
Which competences, qualifications, licences and training are prerequisites for this assignment, and which are merely desirable?
How and when was each prerequisite verified, by whom, and what evidence is held and where?
What happens to the assignment when a required credential expires, is suspended or is revoked, and how far in advance is expiry surfaced?
Beyond skill, does the assignee have the authority and the practical support needed to discharge the assignment, and how is that established?
What screening, vetting or clearance level does this assignment require, and on what risk designation is that based?
What legal right to work or professional registration is required in the work jurisdiction, and until when is it valid?
Who is accountable for re-screening, and at what interval or on which triggering events?
How is a failed, lapsed or downgraded check handled without exposing the underlying sensitive result to assignment consumers?
Which other roles or assignments may this assignee not hold at the same time under a static separation rule?
Which role combinations may be held but not activated or exercised together in a single session or transaction?
How many concurrent holders may this post or role have, what minimum coverage must exist, and what happens when either bound is breached?
Which conflicts of interest or related-party relationships must be declared before the assignment is made, and were they?
Which validation rules are blocking rather than advisory, who may grant an exception, and how are pre-existing violations of a newly introduced rule treated?
Which agent authorized this assignment, acting in which role, and at what instant?
On what documented basis was the assignment authorized, such as a requisition, funded establishment, staffing order or operational plan?
Was the authorizer permitted to authorize an assignment of this type, scope and authority level, and how was that checked?
How is the approval chain preserved and interpretable after the authorizer's own assignment or employment ends?
Was the assignee given the required written particulars of the assignment, in what form, and by which deadline relative to the start?
Did the assignee acknowledge or accept the assignment, and is acceptance a precondition of activation?
Which third parties must be notified that this assignment exists, with what content, and by when?
Where the assignment places the worker under a high-risk automated system, were the affected workers and their representatives informed before the system was put into use?
Which fields of this assignment record constitute personal data or specially protected data, and what is the lawful basis for processing each?
Which roles may read the full record, and which may read only the post, scope and period without the assignee's identity or terms?
How is the assignment published for organizational transparency without disclosing protected attributes or inferring them from adjacent fields?
What is recorded when an assignment record is read, exported or amended, and how long is that log kept?
How long must the assignment record and each class of associated evidence be retained after the assignment ends, and under which rule or minimum?
Which parts of the record may be deleted or anonymized at end of retention while preserving the organizational and succession history?
How does a legal hold or investigation suspend deletion, who may impose and lift it, and how is the suspension evidenced?
When the underlying person record is erased on request, what remains of the assignment and under what justification?
Which external standard representations is this assignment mapped to, at what version, and which of its fields have no counterpart in each?
Which external identifiers exist for the same assignment, and which is authoritative when two systems disagree?
Which downstream systems consume this assignment - directory, access management, payroll, scheduling, statutory register - and how and how often are they reconciled?
Where a target standard conflicts with a local requirement or the mapping is lossy, how is the conflict recorded so that it is visible to consumers rather than hidden?

grok_only.name: What authoritative master-system identifier uniquely identifies this occupancy in the governing HR or personnel register?
What governed IRI, and if none exists what UUID or ULID assigned by the adopting Dimension, identifies this assignment independently of storage format?
Which role-location or registration business identifiers apply to this occupancy, and over which validity interval is each identifier good?
If the same agent later occupies the same role after a gap, is a new assignment instance required rather than reopening the prior identifier?
What kind of occupancy is this, for example primary, concurrent, acting, detail, secondment, time-limited promotion, job-share, volunteer, contractor or unnamed locum?
Is this the agent's primary occupancy, a secondary concurrent occupancy, or an ex officio occupancy derived from another post?
Which role or function codes is the agent authorized to perform under this occupancy?
Does this classification, such as a detail or time-limited promotion beyond 120 days to a higher grade, require competitive procedures under the governing personnel rules?
Which person or other agent occupies this assignment, and what master identifier is used for that agent?
Is the occupancy an unnamed or pre-allocated role with no designated practitioner, and if so what host and role still identify the slot?
Is the holder an organization or post treated as an agent, as permitted for some government ex officio constructions?
If a software or robotic agent is claimed as occupant, what primary HR or personnel source supports that claim, or is the claim marked as a gap?
Which standing post or position, if any, is occupied, and is that post currently allowed to have multiple holders?
Which abstract role or named function does the occupant play, whether or not a standing post exists?
Is this occupancy a membership without a standing post, and if so why is a Post representation not used?
Should holding the post entail an org:Membership with the post's role in the host organization?
Which organization hosts this occupancy, and is that organization the agent's employer?
Which organizational unit contains the occupied post or membership, if finer than the host organization?
If the occupant is seconded, detailed or supplied by another employer, which home organization remains the employer of record?
At which locations or sites is this occupancy authorized to be performed?
Which specialties and services is the occupant authorized to provide under this occupancy?
What official contact details, languages and technical endpoints belong to this occupancy rather than to the person master record?
If locations, services or telecom differ, must this occupancy be split into multiple assignment instances?
During which interval is the occupant authorized to perform the role, including open-ended ends where still authorized?
What are the planned start and end, the actual start and end, and the observation or ingestion times of those facts?
Is the occupancy future-dated, contemporaneous, or retroactive, and what authority supports a retroactive effective time?
Do non-adjacent occupancies of the same role exist, and are they recorded as distinct assignment instances?
What full-time-equivalent or effort fraction is attributed to this occupancy, and from which local policy does that measure come?
Which other occupancies of the same agent overlap this interval, and is concurrency permitted?
Is the occupied post shared among multiple holders, and what share does this occupancy take?
Which other roles or occupancies are forbidden to the same agent at the same time by static or dynamic separation of duty?
Is this assignment record in active use, or has it been marked inactive because it was created in error or is no longer to be used?
What governed lifecycle state applies, such as proposed, approved, scheduled, active, suspended, ended, cancelled or superseded?
If active is false or missing, what if anything may be inferred from period about when the occupancy was in force?
Which personnel action created or replaced this occupancy: appointment, promotion, demotion, reassignment, reinstatement, transfer or another governed action?
Did this position change alter competitive status or tenure, or do the 5 CFR 335.101 rules that status and tenure are unchanged apply?
Was competition required, and if not which noncompetitive or discretionary exception was used?
What reconstruction record of ratings, ranking and selection is retained, and until when?
What time limit applies to this temporary promotion, detail or acting occupancy, and was advance written notice given?
May the occupant be returned at any time to the former or an equivalent position, and is that return exempt from adverse-action procedures cited in 5 CFR 335.102(f)?
How many days of noncompetitive higher-grade detail or time-limited promotion have accrued in the preceding 12 months, and is further competition required?
Was the temporary occupancy originally competed with notice that it might become permanent, allowing conversion without further competition?
Which official or body authorized this occupancy, and under which statute, regulation, collective agreement or delegation?
What lawful basis and, if applicable, Article 88 national or collective rule justifies processing this assignment as employment-context personal data?
Which organization is controller or record owner of the assignment, and who is the operational maintainer of the register?
What minimum qualification, licence or rating-of-record checks were required and what was the outcome?
Which static separation-of-duty or mutually exclusive role pairs forbid this occupant from holding listed other occupancies?
Which dynamic separation-of-duty rules restrict which of the occupant's roles may be active together in one session or duty period?
What minimum and maximum number of simultaneous holders does the occupied post allow?
Was selection for this occupancy made solely on job-related criteria, excluding the non-merit factors listed in 5 CFR 335.103?
Which activity generated this assignment record, which agent was associated with that activity, and to whom is the record attributed?
What notices, contracts, directory entries or reconstruction files evidence this occupancy, and what integrity hash or source identifier do they carry?
If the occupancy or its record was ended or created in error, when was it invalidated, by which activity, and is the historical fact still retained?
What completeness, source reliability and verification status are claimed for this occupancy record?
Who may read, create, amend or delete this occupancy, and which scopes of the model are visible by default?
How long must this assignment record be retained for personnel reconstruction, tax, social security or litigation, and when does storage limitation require deletion or anonymization?
Has the data subject requested erasure, and which legal-obligation or other Article 17 exceptions require refusal for all or part of the occupancy record?
Which emergency, whistleblowing, occupational-health or official-authority exceptions permit access beyond the default need-to-know rule?
Which external Membership, PractitionerRole, EmployeeRole or UA records correspond to this occupancy, and under which mapping profile?
Which known modelling conflicts apply to this occupancy, such as reopened rows versus new instances, or host-not-employer versus employer-only systems?
What fields must be present to exchange this occupancy with a FHIR, ORG or directory consumer without implying unearned conformance?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
